prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production art source sprite sheet for Rail Link Collapse, a portrait mobile steam-train arcade game. Match the user-provided visual reference: detailed crisp chunky pixel art, blackened iron and rusty brown brick underground railway, fiery amber and orange lava rim lighting, charcoal shadows, high contrast readable silhouettes, no smooth painted rendering. Camera ahead and above locomotive looking down at its front, nose toward bottom of screen; not isometric top-down. All artwork isolated on TRUE transparent alpha, no checkerboard painted in, no background scenery, no text, no letters, numbers, labels, borders or watermarks. Use a square 1536x1536 canvas with a strictly regular grid, equal cell sizes, generous transparent gutters, no object crossing its cell, consistent pixel scale and lighting. This is an asset sheet, never a composed gameplay screenshot. Sheet 01 TRAIN. Strict 3 columns x 2 rows, six equal 512x768 cells (canvas 1536x1536). Six views/states of the SAME highly detailed soot-black steam locomotive with large circular bolted front boiler, short chimney, tall rear cab, bronze side pipes, pair of warm yellow headlamps, iron slatted cowcatcher. All same size and pivot bottom center. Row 1: frontal idle; slight left turn nose left still facing viewer; slight right turn nose right still facing viewer. Row 2: frontal damaged with cracked headlamp and sparks; tilting left falling with exposed wheels; tilting right falling with exposed wheels. Locomotives fill 80% of cell height. No tracks under trains, no smoke attached, no wagons, no cast ground shadows. All six objects fully visible.
